admission.justification: An optimistic or refused/unreachable grant overwrite could display authorization the external store did not give; the hook must retain actual state and the served position while pending. Its one-file anchor does not establish cross-file proof.

applicability: The planning-subTask direct-execution hook behind the selected own-page switch.
conditions: A Give/Revoke request uses the existing canonical route against the current served grant.
exclusions: Backend grant storage/permission ownership and task JSON authoring.

evidence: directGrantControl.test.tsx give, pending, refusal and refused-revoke cases

statement: A click changes the grant through the L94 route: disabled while pending with position kept, served state on success, real state plus server words on refusal or unreachable.
